gaps.explanation: Statement Exhibit H (trimmed pp6-7, Proprietary Funds, modified cash basis) Totals 2025 Total operating disbursements/depreciation 433,122 (Electric 337,656, Water 65,598, Sewer 29,868), incl. Depreciation 43,678 (3,985 / 31,296 / 8,397). Business-type detail is Schedule 3 (trimmed p13, Combined Statement of Cash Receipts and Cash Disbursements Compared to Budget - Budgetary Cash Basis), one printed Proprietary line: receipts 563,888 = detail[44] and disbursements 448,419 = detail[45]. 448,419 = 433,122 - depreciation 43,678 + Purchase of capital assets 8,975 (Water Fund, cash flow statement p8) + Transfers to other funds 50,000 (Electric, p6) exactly. The per-fund Exhibit H rows would tie to the statement but their money (except depreciation) is already inside detail[45], which is one printed amount and is neither split nor a true duplicate (different composition), so adding them would double count. Gap -15,297 = -43,678 + 8,975 + 50,000. No fix.

Exhibit H p6 prints 'Transfers to other funds' (50,000) in the Electric Fund 2025 column (Water 0, Sewer 0; Totals (50,000) p7; cash flow statement p8 Electric (50,000)) = JSON business_type.transfers_net -50,000. The 50,000 is already inside the Schedule 3 (p13) Proprietary disbursements line 448,419 = detail[45] (448,419 = 433,122 - 43,678 + 8,975 + 50,000). Adding a Transfers Out line would count the same 50,000 twice in detail; the printed 448,419 cannot be split. No fix.
